name: H-Shipping Multiple Shipping Addresses for WooCommerce
author: hplugin

sections.description:
H-Shipping Multiple Shipping Addresses for WooCommerce allows your customers to save, manage, and select from up to 3 shipping addresses directly within their My Account area and at the Checkout.

This plugin is designed to be lightweight, efficient, and strictly focused on Shipping Addresses, ensuring it never conflicts with billing information or other checkout logic.

Key Features

  • Multiple Addresses: Customers can save up to 3 unique shipping addresses.
  • My Account Integration: Dedicated “Shipping Addresses” tab to Add, Edit, or Delete addresses.
  • Checkout Integration: Seamless AJAX-powered dropdown to select a saved address during checkout.
  • Smart Auto-Fill: Instantly populates shipping fields when an address is selected.
  • Strict Shipping Focus: ONLY updates shipping fields. Does not touch Billing Address, preserving data integrity.
  • Native Compatibility: Works perfectly with WooCommerce’s “Default to customer shipping address” or “Force shipping to billing address” settings.
  • User Friendly: Automatically expands “Ship to a different address” and resets fields when “New Address” is chosen.
  • Multisite Ready: Full support for WordPress Multisite network activation and new site creation.

Usage

  1. Customer: Log in -> Go to My Account -> Click “Shipping Addresses” -> Add a new address.
  2. Checkout: When checking out, select “Ship to a different address”. A dropdown will appear allowing you to select one of your saved addresses.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/h-shipping-multiple-addresses-for-woocommerce directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
    • For Multisite: Network Activate to enable for all sites, or activate on individual sites as needed.
  3. Go to My Account on your frontend to see the new Shipping Addresses tab.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin affect my billing address?

No. This plugin is strictly safe-guarded to only modify Shipping Address fields. If “Force shipping to the customer billing address” is enabled in WooCommerce settings, the plugin will respect that execution flow.

How many addresses can a customer save?

By default, the plugin limits each customer to 3 saved shipping addresses to keep the user interface clean and performant.

Does it work with WordPress Multisite?

Yes! This plugin supports full network activation. It automatically creates the necessary database tables for all existing sites and hooks into new site creation events to ensure seamless compatibility.

Where can users manage their addresses?

A new tab called “Shipping Addresses” is automatically added to the WooCommerce “My Account” page. Users can add, edit, or delete addresses from there.
